title: ONE 10 KT NUKE
OVER A CARRIER GROUP
yt_title: What If 1 Nuke Hit a US Carrier Group at Sea? #shorts

title: ONE 10 KT NUKE AT SEA
THE FALLOUT MAP IS EMPTY
yt_title: Nuke at Sea: The Day After for a Carrier Group #shorts
hook: A simulation: after one air burst over a carrier group, the model draws almost no local fallout, and the Navy's own tests give two histories, not a forecast.

title: 10 KT RINGS
